title: Etale chart fibres of decent spaces have no nontrivial specializations
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $X$ an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], with field-valued point classes and atlas topology [def-a1-space-point-topology]. Suppose every point of $|X|$ is represented by a quasi-compact monomorphism $\operatorname{Spec}F\to X$, for a field $F$ [def-weil-field, def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Monomorphism means injectivity of composition on morphisms from every algebraic space over $S$; quasi-compact means that after any scheme test the inverse image of a quasi-compact open is quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]. Let $p:U\to X$ be a representable etale morphism from a scheme, meaning that every scheme base change is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. If $u,u'\in U$ have $p(u)=p(u')$ and $u'\leadsto u$ (that is, $u$ belongs to the closure of $\{u'\}$), then $u=u'$. No quasi-separatedness or Noetherian hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 03K5 (lemma-decent-no-specializations-map-to-same-point); the decency hypothesis is condition (4) of Tag 03JV (lemma-UR-finite-above-x), via Definition 03I8 (definition-very-reasonable).

proof.text: Put $x=p(u)=p(u\prime)$. Choose an affine open neighbourhood $W\subset U$ of $u$ by [lem-weil-pbc-affine-opens-basis]. Since opens contain every generalization of their points, $u\prime\in W$. Write $a:W\to X$ for the restriction. It remains representable etale: on each scheme test it is an open immersion followed by an etale map, so [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation](1)-(2) applies. Form the scheme $R=W\times_XW$ with etale projections $s,t:R\to W$. Representability and etaleness follow from the scheme-test definition [def-trf-algebraic-space]; the sheaf fibre product has the categorical universal property [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]. In particular $as=at$.

source.place: Tag 03K5 (lemma-decent-no-specializations-map-to-same-point), expanded through Tag 03IM (lemma-no-specializations-map-to-same-point), first paragraph.

proof.text: Choose the quasi-compact field monomorphism $j:\operatorname{Spec}F\to X$ representing $x$ supplied by the hypothesis. The scheme $P=W\times_X\operatorname{Spec}F$ is quasi-compact, by the affine scheme test $W\to X$ for quasi-compactness of $j$, and is etale over $F$, by the scheme-test definition [def-trf-algebraic-space]. By [lem-weil-pbc-etale-fibre-discrete-separable-points], applied over the unique point of $\operatorname{Spec}F$, $P$ has discrete underlying space: its fibre is $P$ itself, since that point's residue-field map is an isomorphism [def-pc-scheme-fibre]. A quasi-compact discrete space is finite, since its singleton open cover has a finite subcover. By [lem-a1-space-point-open-calculus], the image of $|P|\to|W|$ equals $A=|a|^{-1}(\{x\})$. Consequently $A$ is finite. This argument uses only quasi-compactness of the given representative, not quasi-separatedness of $X$.

source.place: Tag 03JV (lemma-UR-finite-above-x), (4) implies (3); Tag 03IM, the finite chart fibre used at the end; spaces-properties.tex Tag 03H4 (lemma-points-cartesian).

proof.text: The etale scheme projections $s,t$ are flat by [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Thus generalizations lift along them by [lem-weil-pbc-flat-generalizations-lift], with orientation $v\prime\leadsto v$: given $r$ and $w\leadsto t(r)$, there is $r\prime\leadsto r$ with $t(r\prime)=w$. Their fibres are discrete by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-fibre-discrete-separable-points] and the fibre-subspace homeomorphism in [def-pc-scheme-fibre]. Hence if two comparable points of $R$ have the same $s$-image, or the same $t$-image, they coincide: their specialization is also a specialization in the discrete fibre subspace. Specialization on $W$ is antisymmetric by [lem-sc-scheme-sober]: mutually specializing points have the same singleton closure, and both are generic points of that irreducible closed set.

source.place: Tag 03IM, using Remark recall: flat generalization lifting (morphisms.tex Tag 03HV, lemma-generalizations-lift-flat) and discrete etale fibres (Tag 02GL, lemma-etale-over-field).

proof.text: Set $v_0=u$ and $v_1=u\prime$, so $v_1\leadsto v_0$ and both are in $A$. The point-fibre-product surjectivity in [lem-a1-space-point-open-calculus] supplies $r_0\in R$ with $t(r_0)=v_0$ and $s(r_0)=v_1$. Recursively suppose $r_n$ has $t(r_n)=v_n$, $s(r_n)=v_{n+1}$ and $v_{n+1}\leadsto v_n$. Lift this last generalization through $t$ using step 3, obtaining $r_{n+1}\leadsto r_n$ with $t(r_{n+1})=v_{n+1}$, and put $v_{n+2}=s(r_{n+1})$. Continuity gives $v_{n+2}\leadsto v_{n+1}$, while $as=at$ implies $a(v_{n+2})=x$. Thus the construction continues with every $v_n\in A$. Only finitely many choices are needed: continue until there are $|A|+1$ points.

source.place: Tag 03IM (lemma-no-specializations-map-to-same-point), tower of lifted specializations and common image in X.

proof.text: If $v_{n+2}=v_{n+1}$, the comparable $r_{n+1},r_n$ have the same $s$-image, so step 3 gives $r_{n+1}=r_n$. Applying $t$ yields $v_{n+1}=v_n$. Every adjacent equality therefore propagates backwards to $v_1=v_0$. But $|A|+1$ points in the finite set $A$ include a repeated pair $v_i=v_j$, $i<j$. The chain gives $v_j\leadsto v_{i+1}\leadsto v_i=v_j$, so antisymmetry from step 3 gives $v_{i+1}=v_i$. If $i=0$ we already have $v_1=v_0$; otherwise backward propagation gives it. Hence $u\prime=u$, as required in the original chart $U$.

source.place: Tag 03IM, last paragraph: equality propagates backwards and finiteness forces the tower to collapse; Tag 03K5 follows.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03K5 via Tag 03IM; finite fibres from Tag 03JV (4) implies (3), expanded in the proof.

The statement is unchanged, and its hypothesis is 03JV(4) decency, matching 03K5. Step 1 checked: affine W∋u (leaf), W→X still representable étale (open immersion then étale), R=W×_XW with étale projections s,t, and as=at from the categorical fibre product. Step 2 checked: P=W×_X Spec F is quasi-compact because j is quasi-compact on the affine test W, and étale over F, so discrete, so finite. The fibre-image equality in lem-a1-space-point-open-calculus gives A=|a|^{-1}(x), so A is finite (the 03JV (4)⇒(3) argument). Step 3 checked: flat lifting has the right orientation, the s- and t-fibres are discrete via the def-pc-scheme-fibre homeomorphism, and specialization is antisymmetric by uniqueness of generic points. Steps 4–5 checked: the tower indices match 03IM (t(r0)=u, s(r0)=u′, r_{n+1}⇝r_n), backward propagation is verified, and pigeonhole plus antisymmetry give u=u′. The induction is explicit and finite. There are no new nodes. No existing node duplicates the item: qs-space-etale-specializations needs a quasi-compact diagonal, finite-groupoid-orbit-incomparability needs finite s and t, and the decency-criterion nodes state the converse. The 7 declared tool_uses are all generic scheme/space foundations and are accepted.
